draft_statement: Draft core: describe the GPS-like value 5.47 as a composite difference from the reference. It does not classify overall gait as normal or abnormal.

draft_statement: Draft core: identify these leading displayed joint-curve differences: Hip GVS 7.55 degrees; Pelvis GVS 5.56 degrees. Choose which joints actually deserve emphasis; ranking is not clinical severity.
evidence:
- HipAngles: range of motion 42.5 deg, Gait Variable Score 7.55
- PelvisAngles: range of motion 1.7 deg, Gait Variable Score 5.56
proposed_components: Named joint findings selected by the expert. No unseen waveform direction or phase is required.
selection_basis: Two largest displayed GVS values, including ties at the cutoff; not an automatic importance rule.

draft_statement: Draft core: describe Tibialis anterior (TA) as above the phase-specific reference mean at about 60% of the analysis cycle, with displayed max |z| 2.1. Decide whether it merits inclusion or replace it with a more relevant input-supported finding.
evidence: - TA: above-threshold interval(s) 12%-17%; 30%-40%; 55%-79%; 83%-11% (wraps cycle boundary), 67% of cycle above threshold, above threshold across cycle boundary, peak normalized amplitude 0.64, max |z| vs healthy reference: 2.1 (above reference, at 60% of cycle)
proposed_components: Muscle AND mean-relative direction AND approximate cycle location; magnitude provides descriptive context, not a diagnostic threshold.
selection_basis: One of two largest displayed max-|z| values; alphabetical tie-break only selects a review candidate. No uniqueness or exact rank is required.

draft_statement: Optional candidate for a core finding: Erector spinae (ERS) has 70% displayed above-threshold coverage. Select this only if the envelope-extent finding adds useful case-specific content; otherwise omit it. Use the retained intervals in the input if helpful.
evidence: - ERS: above-threshold interval(s) 45%-58%; 83%-37% (wraps cycle boundary), 70% of cycle above threshold, above threshold across cycle boundary, peak normalized amplitude 0.66, max |z| vs healthy reference: 1.2 (below reference, at 56% of cycle)
proposed_components: If retained, describe measured above-threshold extent. Do not equate rounded coverage with continuous physiological activation or absence of brief threshold gaps.
